_doc: Hand-written meaning for each command form. commands.<route>.description is what the command Choice sees; keywords feed the retriever only. args.<route>.<arg>: choice args get question/stated/options (option keys are literal CLI tokens and override the parsed values); flags get question. Routes not listed fall back to the CLI summary; args not listed get a generic question.

omarchy theme set.description: switch the whole desktop to a different named colour theme or look (colour scheme, palette, rice)

omarchy theme switcher.description: open a picker to browse and choose a colour theme visually, without naming one

omarchy theme current.description: tell the user which colour theme is active right now

omarchy theme list.description: list every colour theme that is installed and available

omarchy theme bg next.description: change the desktop wallpaper to the next background image of the current theme

omarchy theme bg-switcher.description: open a picker to browse and choose a desktop wallpaper or background image

omarchy theme bg current.description: show which wallpaper or background image is in use

omarchy theme bg install.description: open the folder where the user can add their own wallpapers for the current theme

omarchy theme bg intro.description: turn the animated intro that plays when the wallpaper changes on or off

omarchy theme bg boot intro.description: play the current wallpaper's theme intro animation now

omarchy theme install.description: install a new colour theme from a git repository or URL

omarchy theme update.description: update colour themes that were installed from git to their latest version

omarchy theme refresh.description: re-apply and regenerate the current theme from its templates, to fix apps that did not pick up the theme or to apply theme changes

omarchy theme set templates.description: regenerate all themed app config files from the theme templates so theme changes are applied

omarchy theme set browser.description: apply the current theme colour to Chromium, Chrome, Edge and Brave

omarchy theme set vscode.description: apply the current theme to VS Code, VSCodium and Cursor

omarchy theme set obsidian.description: apply the current theme to Obsidian notes vaults

omarchy theme set gnome.description: apply the current theme to GNOME/GTK apps: dark or light mode and icons

omarchy theme set tmux.description: apply the current theme to tmux

omarchy theme set foot.description: apply the current theme colours to open Foot terminal windows

omarchy theme set glass.description: give terminals, btop and GTK apps a see-through glass background while windows are glassy

omarchy theme set claude.description: apply the current theme to Claude Code

omarchy theme set keyboard.description: light the keyboard backlight in the current theme's colour (RGB keyboards)

omarchy theme set herdr machines.description: copy the current theme to the user's other herdr machines running Omarchy

omarchy bar position.description: move the bar (top bar, status bar, panel, waybar) to a different edge of the screen

omarchy bar background.description: change how the bar (top bar, status bar, panel) background looks: solid, glassy see-through, or no background

omarchy bar reset.description: reset the bar (top bar, panel) layout and widgets back to defaults

omarchy bar defaults.description: show the default bar (top bar, panel) layout and widgets

omarchy bar text color.description: pick a readable text colour for a see-through bar (top bar, panel)

omarchy toggle bar.description: hide or show the bar (top bar, status bar, panel, waybar) without restarting anything

omarchy toggle nightlight.description: turn the night light (warm blue-light filter, redshift, night shift) on or off

omarchy toggle idle.description: keep the computer awake (stop the screen locking or sleeping when idle), or let it idle and lock normally again

omarchy toggle animations.description: turn window animations, blur and shadows off or back on (to make the desktop faster or snappier)

omarchy toggle fullscreen desktop.description: zen mode: hide the top bar and remove window gaps together for a distraction-free full screen desktop

omarchy toggle notification silencing.description: do not disturb: silence or unsilence notifications

omarchy toggle touchpad.description: disable or enable the laptop touchpad / trackpad

omarchy toggle touchscreen.description: disable or enable the touch screen

omarchy toggle screensaver.description: allow or prevent the screensaver from appearing

omarchy toggle suspend.description: show or hide the suspend option in the system menu

omarchy toggle hybrid gpu.description: switch a hybrid-graphics laptop between the dedicated GPU and the integrated GPU

omarchy toggle theme sync.description: turn mirroring of theme changes to and from herdr machines on or off

omarchy toggle crash capture.description: turn crash report notifications on or off

omarchy toggle input device.description: enable, disable or toggle the touchpad or touchscreen input device

omarchy capture screenshot.description: take a screenshot (screen capture, screengrab, snip, print screen) of the screen, a region, or a window

omarchy capture screenrecording.description: start, stop or check a recording of the screen (screen recording, screencast), optionally with sound, microphone or webcam overlay

omarchy capture screenrecording with web.description: choose which webcam to use from a list, then start a screen recording with it

omarchy capture text.description: grab text from part of the screen with OCR, e.g. copy text out of an image

omarchy capture qr.description: scan or read a QR code shown on the screen

omarchy capture webcam resize.description: make the webcam overlay in a screen recording bigger or smaller

omarchy capture webcam list.description: list the webcams / cameras available for recording

omarchy audio output volume.description: make the speaker/headphone volume louder or quieter, or mute and unmute the sound

omarchy audio output switch.description: switch sound output to a different device, e.g. between speakers and headphones

omarchy audio source switch.description: move media playback to the next or previous media player / source

omarchy audio tuning.description: turn the laptop speaker tuning (sound enhancement) on or off

omarchy restart audio.description: restart the sound system to fix audio that stopped working or a stuck USB audio device

omarchy brightness display.description: show, raise, lower or set the screen brightness, or turn the display off or on

omarchy brightness keyboard.description: change the keyboard backlight brightness (keyboard light)

omarchy restart wifi.description: restart the wifi / wireless service, to fix a dropped or stuck wifi connection

omarchy restart bluetooth.description: unblock and restart bluetooth, to fix bluetooth problems

omarchy network speedtest.description: test how fast the internet connection is

omarchy network status.description: show which network is connected and its status

omarchy network qr.description: show a QR code for sharing the wifi network and password

omarchy network band.description: show or choose which wifi frequency band (2.4, 5 or 6 GHz) is used

omarchy dns.description: show or change which DNS provider the system uses (Cloudflare, Google, automatic)

omarchy font set.description: change the system / terminal monospace font to a named font

omarchy font current.description: tell the user which font is in use right now

omarchy font list.description: list the monospace fonts that are available

omarchy display text size.description: make text and UI bigger or smaller everywhere (scale text size), or reset it

omarchy hyprland monitor scaling.description: show or change the monitor / display scaling (zoom everything in or out on screen)

omarchy hyprland monitor internal.description: turn the built-in laptop screen off or on (e.g. when using an external monitor)

omarchy hyprland monitor internal mirror.description: mirror the laptop screen onto an external monitor or projector, or stop mirroring

omarchy hyprland window transparency.description: make all windows solid, see-through, or glassy

omarchy hyprland window transparency tog.description: toggle see-through transparency for just the focused window

omarchy hyprland window gaps toggle.description: turn the gaps (spacing) between windows on or off

omarchy hyprland window minimize.description: minimize / hide the current window to the dock

omarchy hyprland window pop.description: pop the current tiled window out so it floats pinned on top

omarchy hyprland window tiled fullscreen.description: make the focused window fill the tiled area (fullscreen within tiling) or restore it

omarchy hyprland corners.description: make window corners rounded or sharp (square)

omarchy hyprland workspace layout toggle.description: cycle the current workspace's window layout between tiling, scrolling and floating

omarchy hyprland workspace layout defaul.description: set the default window layout for workspaces: tiling (dwindle), scrolling, or floating

omarchy dock position.description: move the dock to a different edge of the screen

omarchy dock autohide.description: make the dock hide automatically, or stay visible

omarchy system.description: log out, reboot / restart the computer, reboot into the boot menu, or shut down / power off

omarchy screensaver.description: run the screensaver animation in the current terminal

omarchy powerprofiles set.description: change the power profile / power mode: power saver (battery life), balanced, or performance

omarchy battery status.description: show battery charge percentage and power draw

omarchy notification battery.description: show a notification with the battery status

omarchy notification time.description: show a notification with the current time and date

omarchy notification weather.description: show the weather / forecast panel, or hide it

omarchy weather location.description: show or set the location used for the weather

omarchy update.description: update the whole system: Omarchy and all packages (upgrade, check for updates and install them)

omarchy update available.description: check whether an Omarchy update is available, without installing it

omarchy update system pkgs.description: update only the system packages with pacman, not Omarchy itself

omarchy update mise.description: update the mise-managed developer tools (node, ruby, python versions)

omarchy update time.description: resync the system clock / time with the internet

omarchy update pkg prune.description: free disk space by pruning old package versions from the pacman cache

omarchy version.description: show which Omarchy version is installed

omarchy restart shell.description: restart the Omarchy shell (bar, notifications, menus) when it is frozen or glitchy

omarchy restart hyprctl.description: reload the Hyprland window manager configuration

omarchy restart terminal.description: reload terminal emulators so config changes take effect

omarchy restart trackpad.description: reset the trackpad / touchpad driver when it stops working

omarchy launch nautilus.description: open the file manager (Files, Nautilus, file browser)

omarchy launch about.description: show system information (fastfetch: hardware, OS, specs)

omarchy launch docker tui.description: open lazydocker to manage Docker containers

omarchy launch screensaver.description: start the screensaver now, full screen

omarchy menu keybindings.description: show the keyboard shortcuts / keybindings cheat sheet

omarchy setup keyboard.description: choose keyboard layouts / languages for typing

omarchy language.description: show or change the Omarchy interface language

omarchy default browser.description: change which web browser is the default

omarchy default terminal.description: change which terminal app is the default

omarchy default editor.description: change which text / code editor is the default

omarchy default agent.description: change which AI coding agent is the default

omarchy install browser.description: install a web browser (Chrome, Brave, Firefox, Zen, Edge, Chromium)

omarchy install terminal.description: install a terminal app and make it the default

omarchy install dev-env.description: install a programming language / development environment (node, ruby, python, rust, go...)

omarchy install docker dbs.description: install a database (Postgres, MySQL, Redis...) in Docker for development

omarchy pkg install.description: open a picker to search for and install packages / apps from the Arch repos

omarchy pkg aur install.description: open a picker to search for and install packages from the AUR

omarchy pkg remove.description: open a picker to choose installed packages to uninstall

omarchy webapp install.description: create a desktop app launcher for a website (web app)

omarchy tui install.description: create a desktop launcher for a terminal app (TUI)

omarchy share.description: send the clipboard, a file or a folder to another device or phone with LocalSend

omarchy dictation.description: start, stop or toggle voice dictation (speech to text)

omarchy snapshot.description: create a system snapshot (backup point) or restore / roll back to one

omarchy setup factory reset.description: factory-reset the machine, wiping it back to a fresh install

omarchy reminder.description: set a new desktop reminder, asking interactively what and when

omarchy reminder show.description: list the reminders that are currently set

omarchy dock pinned.description: show which apps are pinned to the dock

omarchy weather status.description: print a one-line weather summary for the status bar (used by the bar, not for people)

omarchy launch nautilus cwd.description: open the file manager in the same folder the terminal is in (here, this directory)

omarchy plymouth set by theme.description: style the boot screen / boot splash after a named colour theme

omarchy plymouth current.description: tell the user which theme the boot screen / boot splash uses

omarchy windows vm.description: install, start, stop, check or remove a Windows virtual machine

omarchy install service microsoft.description: install Microsoft Office apps (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, OneDrive) as web apps
